title: Fullstack Developer (Node.js + React + AWS)
description:
About You

You are a hands-on senior engineer who enjoys owning complex systems end-to-end. You are passionate about building scalable, production-grade applications in the cloud and want to contribute to architectural decisions while mentoring others and collaborating with cross-functional teams in a remote-first environment.

You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Computer Science or Software Engineering.
  • 7+ years of experience in software development, with a strong focus on Node.js and TypeScript .
  • Proven experience building full-stack applications using React and TypeScript . Experience with modern React state management patterns.
  • Solid experience designing and operating REST and/or GraphQL APIs .
  • Hands-on experience with AWS serverless services such as Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, and S3.
  • Strong knowledge of event-driven architectures in production environments.
  • Strong experience with DynamoDB in production environments, including single-table design, partition/sort key strategies, TTL, and cost-efficient scaling.
  • Experience supporting hybrid architectures , including coexistence with legacy SQL-based systems.
  • Hands-on experience provisioning infrastructure using AWS CDK or other IaC tools (CloudFormation, Terraform)
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (preferably GitHub Actions).
  • Solid understanding of logging, monitoring, and observability using CloudWatch or similar tools.
  • Strong frontend skills with state management patterns such as React Query, Redux, or Zustand.
  • Advanced English proficiency and ability to collaborate effectively in distributed teams.

You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services using Node.js and TypeScript.
  • Develop and operate high-performance REST and GraphQL APIs.
  • Implement and evolve event-driven architectures using AWS services such as Lambda, SQS, SNS, and API Gateway.
  • Model and optimize data access patterns in DynamoDB, ensuring performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
  • Support system evolution by enabling hybrid architectures during migrations from legacy platforms to serverless solutions.
  • Provision and manage infrastructure using AWS CDK and cloud-native best practices.
  • Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines covering linting, testing, building, deployments, and environment management.
  • Ensure production readiness through proper logging, monitoring, alerting, and observability.
  • Build and maintain frontend applications using React and TypeScript, applying clean component architecture and performance optimizations.
  • Collaborate closely with product, backend, and frontend teams to deliver cohesive full-stack solutions.
  • Participate in architectural discussions, perform code reviews, and promote best engineering practices.

Qualifications

  • Strong experience building full-stack apps with React, Node.js and TypeScript .
  • Hands-on experience with AWS serverless : Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB.
  • Experience designing and operating REST APIs (GraphQL is a plus).
  • Experience working with event-driven architectures in production environments.

Additional Information

About Us

At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: CLM Functional Support Analyst
description:
About UST

Born digital, UST transforms lives through the power of technology. We walk alongside our clients and partners, embedding innovation and agility into everything they do. We help them create transformative experiences and human-centered solutions for a better world.

UST is a mission-driven organization where people, purpose, and technology come together to create meaningful impact. With a strong people-first culture, we empower our teams to innovate, collaborate, and grow while delivering value to our clients and communities worldwide.

We 're looking for aCLM Functional Support Analyst to provides functional support for Contract Lifecycle Management platforms, handling incidents and service requests, supporting end users, and ensuring smooth contract operations across legal, procurement, and business teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide functional support for CLM-related incidents and service requests (L1/L2).

  • Support UAT activities, regression testing, and release validation.
  • Maintain user documentation and knowledge base articles.
  • Provide end-user training and onboarding support.
  • Ensure SLA compliance and provide basic reporting on ticket trends.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in CLM functional support or functional analysis roles.
  • Strong understanding of contract lifecycle processes and legal/procurement workflows.
  • Experience with CLM platforms such as Icertis, Agiloft, Conga, Sirion, SAP Ariba, or similar.
  • Experience working with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira).
  • Basic understanding of ERP/CRM integrations.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Advanced in English (B2+)

Why Join UST?

At UST, you will work in a collaborative and inclusive environment where innovation, learning, and personal growth are encouraged. You will have the opportunity to contribute to impactful projects, work with global teams, and build solutions that truly make a difference.

UST is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Equity Employer . We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.

Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.

Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.

Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload

Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills

Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year

Assegurar a aderência dos processos à Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados – LGPD nos processos da área.

Elaborar/Manter atualizado os manuais de procedimentos e normas operacionais, a fim de preservar a continuidade das atividades atuariais pertinentes.

Suportar discussões técnicas com base na legislação vigente e modelos dos planos de benefícios.

Sugerir e discutir premissas atuariais com base em estudos de aderência de hipóteses e de taxas de juros, bem como avaliar os resultados das avaliações atuariais elaboradas por consultoria externa.

title: JDE CNC Consultant
description:
About Us:

Redfaire is a growing, international technology company headquartered in Limerick, Ireland. Redfaire helps global organisations modernise their JD Edwards environments, migrate to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and unlock value through automation, analytics, and innovation.

Innovation is at the heart of everything at Redfaire, we provide guidance and expertise to our customers in Oracle Cloud, Integrations, AI and Machine Learning.

Headquartered in Limerick, Ireland, we also have offices in UK and USA and a direct presence in other international locations. As a founding partner of Redfaire International, a global network of top-tier JD Edwards consultancies, we’re able to deliver even broader, more impactful solutions to our clients worldwide.

About the Role:

We are currently recruiting a CNC Consultant to join our busy Technical Services Team. The CNC Consultant is responsible for the installation and configuration of JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, including environment setup, user access, security, distributed processing, and version control, as well as testing CNC configurations and controlling software deployment throughout the organisation.

The candidate should have excellent verbal & written communication skills in English & proven analytical and problem-solving skills. The candidate will also need the ability to work in a remote team environment.

Due to the requirement to support our clients in specific time zones, we are seeking appointment of candidates within the LatAm Region.

Responsibilities:

The CNC Consultant role is extremely broad, and responsibilities include (but are not limited to);

  • Oracle ERP (JD Edwards) System Administration, which includes Server and Application Administration, ERP Security Management at user and role level.
  • Planning and installation of business application patches also called electronic software updates or ESUs as well as underlying foundational code or programs called tools releases or service packs
  • Building and deploying changes to the business applications via package management.
  • Management of various business environments & path codes like development, user acceptance testing (UAT) and production, making sure each environment has relevant privileges for users to work with objects in OMW along with required OCM Mapping and Datasources.
  • Ability to Setup and Troubleshoot Printer configuration within JDE, Transform and Print Server
  • Server Manager (the Tools Release 9.1 and above) system management console advance skills.
  • Performance tuning of applications and web servers using Server Manager to analyze kernel processes and obtain log files for detailed analysis.
  • Basic system auditing and performance tuning tasks.
  • Development of software tools and processes to automate repetitive CNC tasks
  • Refreshing and optimization of the underlying database, working with database administrators
  • Experience/expertise with SQL databases such as Oracle, SQL Server with regards to EnterpriseOne
  • Adherence to Redfaire and client Data Protection policies.

Qualifications & Skills:

  • Technical Experience: Minimum 6-7 Years of JDE CNC experience.
  • Expertise in the technical architecture for EnterpriseOne (e.g. Citrix servers, WebLogic servers, WebSphere servers, deployment server, batch/enterprise servers, BSSV servers, mobile apps/AIS servers plus multiple OS's including Windows, Unix/Linux & AS400 can be advantageous)
  • Experience in adding custom environments and custom datasource setups
  • Knowledge of CNC mapping configuration changes using Object Configuration Manager (OCM)
  • Expertise in multiple JDE system software configurations (multi-foundation), Tools Release Updates
  • Relevant 3rd level qualification or equivalent.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal & written.
  • Technical competence with proven analytical skills.
  • Problem solving and trouble shooting skills (which requires a wide range of skills beyond JDE CNC skills such as networking, storage, database, operating system, and virtual infrastructures and the ability to work with people who are experts in these areas)
  • Systematic approach to problem resolution.
  • Ability to work independently under one’s own initiative whilst being part of a global team.
  • Proven ability to be adaptable and to respond to constantly changing demands.
  • Ability to work under pressure & to prioritize.
  • Recognise the importance of customer service and strive to deliver high standards.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft products such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook.

What we offer:

  • Career growth within an expanding global award-winning Oracle Partner recognised for excellence.
  • Supportive team culture with ongoing training and mentorship.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunity to engage in flexible working arrangements, including remote options, to help you maintain a healthy work-life balance.

Redfaire is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to building an integrative culture where everyone feels welcomed and supported. Our inclusive workplace provides an environment that will support your development no matter your gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

Mobiis Campinas, São Paulo, Brasil

Sobre a Mobiis

A Mobiis é um ecossistema que conecta soluções SaaS para aumentar a eficiência e impulsionar a inovação na cadeia logística. Resultado da união entre Fretefy e Pathfind, a empresa oferece tecnologias avançadas como TMS, Marketplace de Fretes e APIs, ajudando clientes e parceiros a otimizarem seus processos logísticos com mais inteligência e escala.

Resumo da função

O SDR (Inbound & Outbound) será responsável por atuar na prospecção ativa e no atendimento de leads inbound, qualificando oportunidades para as soluções SaaS da Mobiis. Seu papel é identificar dores, entender o contexto do prospect, gerar interesse e agendar reuniões ou demonstrações qualificadas para o time de vendas, mantendo um funil de pré-vendas saudável e previsível.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Atuar tanto em outbound (ligações ativas, cadências e prospecção) quanto em inbound (leads vindos de marketing, eventos, formulários e outros canais).
  • Qualificar leads e prospects, entendendo necessidades, desafios, orçamento, perfil decisor e timing.
  • Realizar abordagens consultivas, apresentando de forma objetiva as soluções da Mobiis.
  • Agendar reuniões e demonstrações qualificadas para o time de vendas (closers / executivos de conta).
  • Realizar follow-ups estratégicos ao longo do ciclo inicial de pré-vendas.
  • Registrar e atualizar todas as interações no CRM, garantindo organização e rastreabilidade.

  • Atingir metas mensais de leads qualificados e reuniões agendadas.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência prévia como SDR, Inside Sales ou funções similares, preferencialmente em vendas B2B ou SaaS.
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com clareza, persuasão e resiliência a objeções.
  • Perfil proativo, organizado e orientado a processos e metas.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM e rotina de pré-vendas.
  • Interesse e facilidade para aprender sobre soluções tecnológicas.

  • Vivência em empresas de tecnologia, SaaS ou logística.

  • Inglês intermediário.
  • Capacidade de adaptação a metas desafiadoras e ambientes de rápido crescimento.

title: Almoxarifado/Expedição
description:

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional organizado(a), responsável e com experiência em rotinas de almoxarifado, que também possua conhecimento em inspeção e conferência de qualidade de peças. Valorizamos pessoas atentas aos detalhes, comprometidas com prazos e que prezem pela qualidade e pela boa organização do ambiente de trabalho.

title: Partner Manager
description:
A equipe de folha de pagamento da ADP Global apoia a prestação de serviços de folha de pagamento multinacionais (internacionais) em mais de 140 países. Os serviços internacionais de folha de pagamento da ADP são fornecidos através de uma rede selecionada de parceiros especializados (sendo parceiros da ADP e fornecedores externos) localizados em cada país local.

Objetivo da função:

O objetivo desta função sênior é, em forte colaboração com os líderes regionais da folha de pagamento global, definir e executar aspectos-chave da gestão de negócios e relacionamento executivo para uma rede de parceiros internacionais de subcontratação de folha de pagamento.

1. Responsabilidades:

  • Novos países e parceiros;
  • Planeamento global de novos países parceiros em linha com os objetivos estratégicos;
  • Identificação, seleção e parceiros estratégicos nos territórios escolhidos;
  • Garantir que todos os novos parceiros estejam em conformidade e alinhados com os requisitos da ADP - trabalhando em estreita colaboração com as equipes de conformidade e segurança.

2. Acordos de Subcontratação

  • Negociação e gestão e cumprimento contínuo das obrigações contratuais Corporativas;
  • Ligação e gestão do quadro contratual em estreita relação com o Consultor Jurídico.

3. Gestão de preços de parceiros

  • Apoiar negociações de preços para gerar resultados financeiros mutuamente bem-sucedidos;
  • Lucros e Perdas de Parceiros - Análise de lucratividade e ações proativas para abordar comparações de preços;
  • Fazer uma abordagem proativa para ajustar irregularidades e desalinhamentos.

4. Relações Executivas

  • Estabelecer relacionamentos comerciais sólidos e de longo prazo, mutuamente bem-sucedidos, com líderes parceiros executivos;
  • Explorar outras relações comerciais em apoio a um escopo geográfico mais amplo, serviço e abordagem de backup;
  • Presidir e realizar revisões regulares de negócios, alinhar a estratégia conjunta, documentar ações acordadas e resolver pontos pendentes, usando como contribuição o desempenho dos parceiros de Operações de Parceiros, GSO e auditorias Corporativas, envolvimento dos parceiros em novos projetos e iniciativas;
  • Obter o envolvimento dos parceiros na implantação de projetos estratégicos;
  • Gerenciar, trabalhando em estreita colaboração com o Gerente de Parceiros designado, todos os casos (e problemas) não resolvidos escalados através do processo de prestação de serviços que exigem atenção executiva.

5. Conformidade

  • Como principal ponto de ligação para atividades relacionadas à auditoria do Parceiro;
  • Monitoramento do cumprimento contratual alinhado ao Programa de Riscos de Terceiros da ADP;
  • Garantir que os Parceiros fechem os planos de ação originados das auditorias Corporativas e GSO no devido tempo.

6. Escalações Executivas

  • Atuar como principal elo de ligação com líderes e parceiros da ADP Contato executivo para resolver quaisquer problemas de parceiros que afetem a prestação de serviços e a conformidade com os padrões da ADP;
  • Questões não solucionáveis que só podem ser resolvidas com a alta administração.

Qualificações :

  • Sólida experiência empresarial relevante (conhecimento do setor ou conhecimento relacionado aplicável a serviços de terceirização);
  • Inglês fluente e espanhol intermediário são requisitos;
  • Assertividade, resolução e habilidades de negociação eficazes com líderes empresariais seniores;
  • Capaz de facilitar ativamente reuniões de negócios e interações executivas
  • Trabalhar sob diretrizes e gestão: capacidade de recomendar/fazer julgamentos de negócios sólidos;
  • Atitude orientada para o serviço e flexível, bem organizada e autogerenciada.

Educação:

  • Diploma universitário.

title: Mecânico de manutenção
description:
Executar atividades de manutenção mecânica preditiva, preventiva e corretiva de média e alta complexidade nos equipamentos da empresa, conforme plano de manutenção e/ou manual do equipamento. Reparar e substituir peças, fazer ajustes, lubrificação e regulagem utilizando ferramentas e instrumentos de medição e controle. Inspeção e vistoria de equipamentos e máquinas. Preencher os registros apropriados da área de manutenção. Realizar outras tarefas pertinentes a função.

Responsabilidades do Cargo

  • Substituição de componentes em bombas e redutores, como eixos, rotores, engrenagens, rolamentos, retentores e acoplamentos preventivamente ou corretivamente, verificando ruídos e vibração anormais, alinhando e conservando o equipamento.
  • Executar manutenção em motores elétricos, realizando troca de rolamentos, retentores, tampas e ventoinhas, verificando alinhamento e vibração.
  • Inspeciona, regula, ajusta e realiza intervenção em laminadores, quebradores, peneiras, expanders, extratores e demais equipamentos característicos do segmento.
  • Realiza cheklists de equipamentos, verificando itens pré-definidos para cada um, registrando quando encontrado alguma anormalidade para após serem feitas as intervenções necessárias.
  • Noções de solda para um eventual ajuste de bases e proteções de equipamentos e para manutenção de equipamentos transportadores.
  • Utilização de plasma e maçarico para um eventual ajuste de bases e proteções de equipamentos e para manutenção de equipamentos transportadores.

Requisitos

  • Conhecimento em interpretação de manuais e desenhos técnicos de máquinas e equipamentos.
  • Conhecimento em metrologia, utilizando trenas, paquímetros e demais equipamentos de medição.
  • Conhecimento nas normas técnicas pertinentes às atividades exercidas.
  • Domínio nos procedimentos operacionais de montagem e desmontagem de equipamentos, como bombas, redutores, transportadores, elevadores, etc.
  • Conhecimento na operação de equipamentos de corte, como plasma, esmerilhadeira, policorte, maçarico e moto-esmeril.
  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Curso técnico na área.
